text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: billing/metering anomaly detected (severity: p2) — token-count drift + delayed usage emits in eu-west. Affected services: emitter, aggregator. Alerts: multiple overage flags fired for ~120 accounts. Thread: triage & handoff.

alice_onsite: ack, taking initial triage. @sam_oncall can you join?

sam_oncall: on it. starting investigation. any quick customer impact summary? are charges being applied yet?

kevin_billing: seeing batch of overage emails triggered by the alarm table. Some auto-charge flows didn't run yet but flags are active. Early estimate: ~100-250 customers with elevated token delta in last 2h. Payment holds not executed yet. Logs show spike at 2025-11-12T09:12Z: token_count.delta > alert_threshold.

sam_oncall: ok. maria, can you check emitter and kafka consumer lag? zach, any infra noise?

maria_eng: looking — emitter shows retry storm and increased ack latency. snippets:
```
EMIT_ERR: 2025-11-12T09:10:22Z retry 403 -> backoff
emit_offset: 245678 -> 245892
consumer_lag: 124321
```
Also seeing a surge in small requests that bunched into large batches causing KV cache thrash.

zach_sre: kube node eu-west-3 had transient OOMs on aggregator pods ~09:08-09:14Z, restarted 2 pods. GC pauses correlated with CPU spike. No node-level network issue.

sam_oncall: likely cause = emitter retries + aggregator restarts => windowed batching miscounts + delayed writes. Mitigation plan: 1) pause overage alerting/emailing for affected accounts, 2) apply emitter backpressure patch (reduce max_batch_ms), 3) run conservative backfill to re-emit missing usage, 4) handoff to billing for customer comms.

kevin_billing: will pause email alerts + set billing hold for affected customers. creating internal hold + credit request (PR #1234). I'll also assemble a short customer note for impacted accounts: "we detected transient usage reporting delays; no charges applied until we complete reconciliation."

maria_eng: rolling tiny config change to emitter:
```
kubectl patch deployment emitter -n infra -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"emitter","env":[{"name":"MAX_BATCH_MS","value":"50"}]}]}}}}'
```
Expect lower batch sizes; should stop the retry amplification. Will watch logs.

ota-bot: deploy started for emitter-config-20251112-01 by maria_eng

ota-bot: deploy successful — image emitter:stable@sha256:abc123

sam_oncall: after patch, emitter retry rate down ~80% in last 3m. quick sanity query for token deltas (aggregator materialized view):
```
SELECT count(*) FROM token_flags WHERE created_at > '2025-11-12T08:50Z' AND region='eu-west';
-- before: 238
-- now: 34
```
We'll keep alerting disabled for affected alert IDs until counts stabilize.

kevin_billing: overage flags reduced. I'll run a quick reconcile job to mark these as delayed rather than charged. Starting backfill job for 09:00-10:00 window; estimated runtime 45m.

maria_eng: aggregator backfill job started, tailing logs show steady progress, consumer_lag dropping to ~5k. No further pod restarts.

alice_onsite: good work. I'm going to hand this over to next shift. created ticket IN-2025-987 (billing: delayed usage backfill + customer comms). please add notes if you see residuals. severity -> p3 for monitoring.

sam_oncall: handing to night oncall @eve_night (cc @kevin_billing). Keep monitoring metrics: emitter_retries, consumer_lag, token_flag_count. If token_flag_count jumps > 50 in 10m, page.

kevin_billing: customer comms drafted and queued. will apply temporary credits for any customers accidentally billed during the window. I'll post updates to the ticket.

zach_sre: infra note: upgraded oom_kill protection on aggregator node pool; will monitor for 6h.

sam_oncall: summary: root cause = emitter retry amplification + aggregator restarts -> delayed writes and duplicate windowed counts producing overage flags. Mitigations applied: alerting paused, emitter param tightened, backfill started, billing holds/credits prepared. Monitoring for 2h. moving to watch mode.

alice_onsite: handoff complete. next check-in in 30m. :white_check_mark:
